_comment: Your overrides. Every leaf string here that matches a leaf in template-baseline.json (by path) becomes a replacement slot. Add fields under any structure you like.

colors._comment: { '#oldHex': '#newHex' } — both hex and rgb() forms are auto-expanded

images._comment: assets: { destFileName: srcRelToProject } — copies your image into dist/<dir>/. dirs: array of dest dirs (defaults to ['images']).

replacements._comment: { originalCdnFilename: newFilename } — rewrites every reference in the html/js bundle
